additional_context: Observation is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. A later Applied issue, FHIR-31081, intentionally broadened the same Observation wording to include environments and is already represented on the combined branch; that later context should be preserved. OO/BR&R minutes corroborate the FHIR-29032 discussion, planned application, and completed application, and no conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current Observation introduction retains the requested product/substance scope while also including the later approved environment expansion.
